name: Idol to Yaru Tatta Hitotsu no Saeta Houhou
original_name: アイドルと姦るたったひとつの冴えた方法
source:
What's the best way to go about getting with a celebrity?
The last time I knew Takamami was around the 6th grade. We used to be playmates.
She went on to become an idol of pop group MGN45, but I knew her before her fame. That was my "in".
But her schedule was jam packed. She lived a busy life. It was very hard to just visit her.
So, I followed her like a raving fan. Every event, every appearance, every public handshake.
One day I got an email from her ...

translation:
和明星在一起最好的方式是什么？我最后一次认识高见是在六年级左右。我们曾经是玩伴。她后来成为了偶像团体MGN45的成员，但我在她成名之前就认识她了。这就是我的“切入点”。但她的日程排得满满的。她过着忙碌的生活。想去看她都非常困难。于是，我像狂热粉丝一样追随着她。每一场活动、每一次亮相、每一次公开握手。有一天，我收到了她发来的邮件……
